description: This Dart source file defines data models related to tasks in a task management application. It includes classes for task fields constants, representing schema details and the Task class itself with serialization and copy functionality.

classes.name: TaskFields
classes.description: Contains static constants for database column names related to tasks, and a list of all field names.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Represents a task entity with properties like id, taskName, note, status flags, due date/time, and list name. Includes serialization methods and a copy method.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a new instance of Task, copying existing values and allowing specific fields to be overridden.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a Task object from a JSON map.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts a Task object into a JSON map for storage or transmission.
